```{r setup}
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 0, 0, 0, unit = "pt"),
      legend.box.margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 0, 0, 0, unit = "pt"),
      panel.spacing = unit(1, 'lines'),
      plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(0, 0, 0, 0, unit = "pt"),

      strip.placement = 'outside'

theme_set(theme_sovacool)

set.seed(20240326)
```


## Accomplished

- Refactored analysis code to improve runtime after correcting sample matches.
- Re-construct TF-peak network with TF footprints from HINT-ATAC.
- Link ATAC peaks to genes from RNA expression with similar method as Tang _et al._.
  - Select peaks within a 0.5mbp window around gene TSSs.
  - Run Pearson correlation on peak scores & gene counts, filter peak-gene links by FDR < 0.01.
- Re-rank top TFs per cluster.

## Top TFs

```{r TFs_HINT}
plot_heatmap_row <- function(dat, value_column = A_diff,
                             scale_fill = scale_fill_viridis_c) {
  dat %>%
    ggplot(aes(
      x = gene_name, y = 1, # y = diff,
      fill = {{ value_column }}
    )) +
    geom_tile() +
    facet_wrap(~cluster_id, nrow = 1, scales = "free") +
    labs(
      y = quo_name(enquo(value_column)),
      x = ""
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, vjust = 1, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    )
}
top_tfs_hint <- read_csv(params$top_tfs_hint)

# plot TFs patchwork
(plot_heatmap_row(top_tfs_hint, outdegree) +
  colorspace::scale_fill_continuous_diverging(palette = 'Blue-Red') +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())
) /
  (plot_heatmap_row(top_tfs_hint, expression) +
    colorspace::scale_fill_continuous_diverging(palette = 'Green-Orange') +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_blank()
    )
  ) /
  (plot_heatmap_row(top_tfs_hint, accessibility) +
       colorspace::scale_fill_continuous_diverging(palette = 'Purple-Green')  +
    theme(strip.text = element_blank()))
```

## chromVAR - variability in accessibility {visibility="hidden"}

```{r chromvar_clusters}
plot_top_var_tfs <- function(var_df, n_top = 20,
                             title_str = glue::glue("Top {n_top} TFs by variability in accessibility")) {
    top_tfs <- var_df %>%
      slice_max(order_by = variability, n = n_top) %>%
      arrange(desc(variability)) %>%
      mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
      arrange(variability)
    var_plot_top <- top_tfs %>%
      mutate(tf = factor(name, levels = top_tfs %>% pull(name))) %>%
      ggplot(aes(
        y = tf,
        x = variability,
        xmin = bootstrap_lower_bound,
        xmax = bootstrap_upper_bound
      )) +
      geom_pointrange() +
      labs(
        y = "",
        title = title_str
      ) +
      theme_bw()
    return(var_plot_top)
}
load("output/chromvar_subset/chromVAR.c1.RData")
variability_c1 <- variability
load("output/chromvar_subset/chromVAR.c2.RData")
variability_c2 <- variability
load("output/chromvar_subset/chromVAR.c3.RData")
variability_c3 <- variability

var_df <- bind_rows(
    variability_c1 %>% mutate(cluster_id = 'c1'),
    variability_c2 %>% mutate(cluster_id = 'c2'),
    variability_c3 %>% mutate(cluster_id = 'c3')
)
var_plots <- c('c1','c2','c3') %>%
    map(\(x) var_df %>% filter(cluster_id == x) %>% plot_top_var_tfs(title = glue("{x} Top TFs")))
var_plots[[1]] + var_plots[[2]] + var_plots[[3]]
```

## Differential ATAC & RNA-seq Correlation {visibility="hidden"}

<!--
Inspiration

- Fig. 4B from <https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC9581296/figure/F4/>
- Fig. 2A-B from <https://epigeneticsandchromatin.biomedcentral.com/articles/10.1186/s13072-019-0260-2/figures/2>
-->

```{r read}
#| message: false
diff_dat <- read_tsv(params$atac_rna_tsv) %>%
    mutate(cluster_id = as.factor(cluster_id))
```


```{r corr_all_genes, message=FALSE}
alpha_level <- 0.05
log2fc_thresh <- 0 # setting to zero removes filtering by log2FC

cor_logfc <-  cor.test(diff_dat$log2FoldChange_atac,
         diff_dat$log2FoldChange_rna,
         method = "spearman") %>%
    tidy()
#cor_logfc %>% kable()

lm_logfc <- diff_dat %>%
    lm(log2FoldChange_atac ~ log2FoldChange_rna, .)
lm_rsq <- summary(lm_logfc)$r.squared

abs_max <- 5.004292 # from filtered data below. this will exclude some points from the unfiltered data.

diff_dat %>%
    mutate(across(starts_with('log2FoldChange'), ~ round(., 2))) %>%
    mutate(signif = case_when(
        pvalue_atac < alpha_level & pvalue_rna < alpha_level ~ TRUE,
        TRUE ~ FALSE)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(signif) %>% # plot true on top of false
    ggplot(
        aes(
            y = log2FoldChange_atac,
            x = log2FoldChange_rna
        )
    ) +
    geom_hline(
        yintercept = 0,
        linetype = 'dashed',
        color = 'darkgrey'
    ) +
    geom_vline(
        xintercept = 0,
        linetype = 'dashed',
        color = 'darkgrey'
    ) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = signif), alpha = 0.7, shape = 21, stroke = 0) +
    geom_smooth(method = lm,
                linewidth = 0.5,
                se = FALSE, show.legend = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#252525", `FALSE` = "#D9D9D9")) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(title = glue('ATAC & RNA\np-values < {alpha_level}'))) +
    lims(x = c(-abs_max, abs_max),
         y = c(-abs_max, abs_max)) +
    labs(y = 'ATAC log2(FC)', x = 'RNA log2(FC)')
```

Spearman's rho: `r cor_logfc$estimate` (p-value < 2.2e-16)


## Correlation within clusters {visibility="hidden"}

```{r}

cor_logfc <- diff_dat %>%
    group_by(cluster_id) %>%
    do(tidy(
        cor.test(.$log2FoldChange_atac, .$log2FoldChange_rna,
                 method = "spearman")
    )) %>%
    select(cluster_id, estimate, p.value) %>%
    rename(cluster = cluster_id, `Spearman's Rho` = estimate, `p-value` = p.value) %>%
    mutate(`p-value` = case_when(`p-value` < 0.05 ~ '< 0.05',
                               TRUE ~ '>= 0.05'))
kable(cor_logfc)
```


## Differential ATAC & RNA-seq Correlation {visibility="hidden"}

```{r corr_signif_genes, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, out.width='80%'}

min_max <- list(min = ~ min(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
                max = ~ max(.x, na.rm = TRUE))
plot_corr_line <- function(dat, plot_lm = FALSE) {

    abs_max <- dat %>%
        summarize(across(starts_with('log2FoldChange'), min_max)) %>%
        as.list() %>% unname() %>% unlist() %>% abs() %>% max()
    corr_line_plot <- dat %>%
        mutate(across(starts_with('log2FoldChange'), ~ round(., 2))) %>%
        ggplot(
            aes(
                y = log2FoldChange_atac,
                x = log2FoldChange_rna,
                color = cluster_id,
                group = cluster_id,
                text = glue(
                    'gene name:\t{gene_name}',
                    'cluster:\t{cluster_id}',
                    'ATAC log2(FC):\t{log2FoldChange_atac}',
                    'RNA log2(FC):\t{log2FoldChange_rna}',
                    .sep = '\n'
                )
            )
        ) +
        geom_hline(
            yintercept = 0,
            linetype = 'dashed',
            color = 'darkgrey'
        ) +
        geom_vline(
            xintercept = 0,
            linetype = 'dashed',
            color = 'darkgrey'
        ) +
        geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
        {if (isTRUE(plot_lm)) geom_smooth(linewidth = 0.5, method=lm, se=FALSE) } +
        scale_color_viridis_d() +
        guides(color = guide_legend(title = 'cluster')) +
        lims(x = c(-abs_max, abs_max),
             y = c(-abs_max, abs_max)) +
        labs(y = 'ATAC log2(FC)', x = 'RNA log2(FC)')
    return(corr_line_plot)
}


diff_dat_filt <- diff_dat %>%
  filter(pvalue_rna < alpha_level, pvalue_atac < alpha_level,
         abs(log2FoldChange_atac) >= log2fc_thresh, abs(log2FoldChange_rna) >= log2fc_thresh)


lm_logfc <- diff_dat_filt %>%
    group_by(cluster_id) %>%
    do(tidy(lm(
        log2FoldChange_atac ~ log2FoldChange_rna, .
    )))


ggplotly(
  diff_dat_filt %>% plot_corr_line(plot_lm = TRUE),
  tooltip = 'text'
 )
```

Genes filtered to p-value < `r alpha_level` for both ATACseq & RNAseq log2FC

## Expression & accessbility

```{r gene_quadrants, out.width='80%'}
diff_dat_filt_cat <- diff_dat_filt %>%
    mutate(category = case_when(
        log2FoldChange_rna > 0 & log2FoldChange_atac > 0 ~ 'HE-HA',
        log2FoldChange_rna > 0 & log2FoldChange_atac < 0 ~ 'HE-LA',
        log2FoldChange_rna < 0 & log2FoldChange_atac > 0 ~ 'LE-HA',
        log2FoldChange_rna < 0 & log2FoldChange_atac < 0 ~ 'LE-LA',
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ))

p <- diff_dat_filt_cat %>%
        mutate(across(starts_with('log2FoldChange'), ~ round(., 2))) %>%
        ggplot(
            aes(
                y = log2FoldChange_atac,
                x = log2FoldChange_rna,
                color = category,
                group = category,
                text = glue(
                    'gene name:\t{gene_name}',
                    'cluster:\t{cluster_id}',
                    'ATAC log2(FC):\t{log2FoldChange_atac}',
                    'RNA log2(FC):\t{log2FoldChange_rna}',
                    .sep = '\n'
                )
            )
        ) +
        geom_hline(
            yintercept = 0,
            linetype = 'dashed',
            color = 'darkgrey'
        ) +
        geom_vline(
            xintercept = 0,
            linetype = 'dashed',
            color = 'darkgrey'
        ) +
        geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
        scale_color_viridis_d() +
        guides(color = guide_legend(title = '')) +
        lims(x = c(-abs_max, abs_max),
             y = c(-abs_max, abs_max)) +
        labs(y = 'ATAC log2(FC)', x = 'RNA log2(FC)')

ggplotly(p, tooltip = 'text')
```

- HE-HA: High Expression (RNAseq) and High Accessibility (ATACseq)
- LE-LA: Low Expression (RNAseq) and Low Accessibility (ATACseq)

## Expression & accessbility

```{r he-ha_genes, width='100%'}
plot_venn_categories <- function(dat, expr_category = 'HE-HA') {
  dat %>%
    filter(category == expr_category) %>%
    select(gene_name, cluster_id) %>%
    arrange(gene_name) %>%
    unstack() %>%
    Venn() %>%
    process_data() %>%
    plot_venn() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c() +
    labs(title = expr_category) +
    theme(legend.position = 'none')
}
categories <- diff_dat_filt_cat %>% pull(category) %>% unique() %>% sort()
plots <- map(categories, plot_venn_categories, dat = diff_dat_filt_cat)

plot_grid <- ggplot() +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
               linetype = 'dashed',
               color = 'darkgrey') +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
               linetype = 'dashed',
               color = 'darkgrey') +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0)) +
    labs(x = 'Expression (RNA)', y = 'Accessibility (ATAC)') +
    theme(axis.line = element_line(arrow = grid::arrow()))
# use patchwork to compose single plot
plot_grid +
    inset_element(plots[[1]], left = 0.5, bottom = 0.5, right = 1, top = 1) + # upper right
    inset_element(plots[[3]], left = 0, bottom = 0.5, right = 0.5, top = 1) + # upper left
    inset_element(plots[[2]], left = 0.5, bottom = 0, right = 1, top = 0.5) + # lower right
    inset_element(plots[[4]], left = 0, bottom = 0, right = 0.5, top = 0.5)   # lower left
```


## Top enriched GO terms in HE-HA gene sets

```{r clusterProfiler, fig.width=9, fig.height=7}
load(params$clusterprofiler_rdata)

n_top <- 10
enrich_plot <- enrich_results %>%
  mutate(ID = str_replace_all(ID, "_", " ") %>% str_wrap(width = 80)) %>%
  group_by(cluster_id) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = gene_ratio, n = n_top) %>%
  mutate(name = fct_reorder(ID, .x = Count)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(gene_ratio, name, size = Count, #color = cluster_id,
             text = glue("Gene Ratio: {GeneRatio}\n{name}"))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~cluster_id, scales = 'free', nrow = 3
             ) +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  labs(
    #title = glue("Top {n_top} enriched GO terms in HE-HA genes"),
    y = ""
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    #axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45)
  )
enrich_plot
ggplotly(enrich_plot, tooltip = 'text')
```

::: {.notes}
- Gene Ratio: genes of interest that match the GO term / total genes of interest
- Count: genes of interest that match the GO term (i.e. numerator of Gene Ratio)

y axis order is by Count
:::
